From the editor

One photo was never enough.

You know, no single photo of you ever feels complete. So I made an entire magazine, just for you.

On the cover is that little girl with a bow, completely serious. I think that was the day it was decided she would be the boss of her own life.

Inside, every picture is you: in the yellow suit, on film, and in that mirror selfie where you hide behind your phone. Scroll through and tell me which page is your favourite.

— Editor-in-chief, and your biggest fan

Feature

Same eyes.

Then: a bow, a bun and a very serious face. Now: the same big eyes, with a lot more mischief.

Style

Golden hour.

Peach and sage drapes, a lantern and an open night sky. The whole venue was glowing, but my eyes were only on the yellow suit.

Fashion note: this colour only looks this good on you. The rest of the party was just background.

Column

Off duty.

Things only I notice:

  • The nose pin that catches every light.
  • The half smile that shows up before the full one.
  • Hair falling over her face, and she lets it.
  • A top that says “favourite”. I agree.
  • Hiding behind the phone in every mirror.
